Package com.splendor.network

Class ServerSocketHandler

java.lang.Object
com.splendor.network.ServerSocketHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
NetworkMessageHandler
public class ServerSocketHandler extends Object implements NetworkMessageHandler
Network server that handles remote client connections. Uses thread-per-client model for concurrent player handling.

    • waitForClients

      public boolean waitForClients(int count, long timeoutMs)
      Blocks until the given number of clients have connected, or the timeout elapses.
      Parameters:
      count - Number of clients to wait for
      timeoutMs - Maximum wait time in milliseconds (0 = wait forever)
      Returns:
      true if the required clients connected in time, false on timeout

    • waitForAtLeastClients

      Returns:
